risks.risk: PS4 model variant is unclear (Fat vs Slim vs Pro). Price changes a lot by variant.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the console label/model number (e.g., CUH-xxxx) and a photo of the system settings page showing 'PS4' model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-value PS4 variant among the comparables (worst case for model uncertainty).

risks.risk: No proof it actually boots/works (disc drive, HDMI output, controllers pairing).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip showing the PS4 turning on to the home screen and the controllers working (buttons + analog movement).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst case), using the cheapest matching PS4 comparable.

risks.risk: Installed games claim may be false or fewer than stated; could be locked/region issues.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo/screenshot of the Games section showing at least 5 installed titles (or the storage breakdown).
risks.if_unproven: Price as having no proven extra value from installed games.

risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing all included items laid out (power cable, HDMI, controller charging cable if any, and any other accessories).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + controllers only (worst case for missing cables).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the PS4 console label/model number (CUH-xxxx) and a system settings screen showing the model.
Short video: PS4 boots to home screen; show both controllers connected and working.
Screenshot/photo of the Games library showing at least 5 installed games.
Photo of all included accessories laid out (power + HDMI + any other cables).
response.reason: The photo confirms a PS4 with controllers, but the key details that determine price (exact PS4 variant, working status, and installed games) are not provable from the single image.
